title: Best Shampoo (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the cited sources: Consumer Reports, CNET, NYPost, The Good Trade, and Allure. Preference was given to items mentioned by more than one source and to those with clear functional claims.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price information is included.
